disclosures.issue_104_input_paths: cohort.load_plan's input re-hash fails on exactly ['.local-artifacts/issue-96-tau-ad-within-checkpoint-v1/plan.json', '.local-artifacts/issue-104-capture-dev/summary.json']; their diffs against the committed bytes are machine-local home-directory path rewrites only, so the #104 plan is read directly and any other changed input refuses

renderer_libraries.note: the Mesa 26.1.2 / LLVM 22.1.6 build under ~/.cache/novphy-mesa was rebuilt on this host (2026-10-14; embedded install paths differ); the renderer string is checked per execution and decision / final frames are compared byte for byte with the recorded #104 frames (reported)

execution.launch: each stage launched once with recorded PIDs and waited on; never relaunched over live workers
execution.limits: #104 plan limits verbatim (16 isolated workers, port blocks from 29100, cold-start gate, no retries) except the artifact cap

guards.G1: scoring policy on every decision record
guards.G2: re-ranking identity across shots and retained #101/#114 grid rows on N1-mixed shot-1 cells
guards.G3: chronology: freeze <= first decision <= first dispatch
guards.G4: live decision frame E99 parse within the parse tolerance of the anchor
guards.G5: execution integrity: one live execution per chosen level x candidate, a verdict for each, no candidate repeated in an episode, no incomplete episode
guards.failure: a failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient

known_before_freeze: every published #101/#103/#105/#114 grid ranking on the N1 mixed levels (including #103 top-3 hit, which equals recorded-replay pass@3 under this semantics) and the #104 verdict yields; no model output on the 89 N1 levels without a recorded pass or on any #110 evaluation level; no live #102 execution on an evaluation level

projection.rule: worst case = every grid candidate of every level executed once (sharing caps executions at levels x 16); #104 amortized branch wall at 16 workers

semantics.decision_frame: N1: the Gate-B anchor store (E99 parse of shot frame 0 of the level's first complete recorded candidate); N2: the same rule parsed here after the freeze; guard G4 checks the live shot frame 0 of every complete execution against it
semantics.episode: retry-from-start: every shot k resets the same single-bird level to its start state; before each shot the planner ranks the frozen 16-launch grid from the level's decision frame with its model or rule, excludes candidates already executed and failed in the episode, and picks the best remaining one; the launch is executed live in the #104 player
semantics.native_clear: level-clear terminal reported descriptively (pass@3 under native_clear)
semantics.pass: live engine pig removal (`pig_removed`, #85 channel via capture_pipeline_v2.branch_outcome)
semantics.per_decision_compute: CUDA-synchronized rollout seconds (block gpu_seconds) and host decision seconds of ranking all 16 candidates, one process per RTX 5090, warm-up level discarded per arm x seed x shot; linear MACs per decision = the rollout's linear MACs (#96/#101 accounting)
semantics.ranking: lowest #111 tie-free endpoint cost over the 16 candidates (ties to the lower ordinal; nonfinite endpoints last); prior: Gate-B rule (minus the fit-split success frequency of the identical action), ties to the lower ordinal; random: one PCG64([102, seed, level index]) permutation per seed and level, first non-excluded entry (uniform without replacement); oracle: recorded passing candidates, lowest ordinal first, no shot when none is recorded
semantics.recorded_outcomes: the recorded #104 verdicts are only (a) the oracle's inventory and (b) a declared cross-check (live vs recorded verdict; recorded-replay pass@3); never the result
semantics.replan_disclosure: the state never changes between shots, so replanning amounts to excluding failed candidates; the model re-ranks at every shot (re-ranking identity is guard G2)
semantics.request_mix: adaptive arms: shares of imagined rollout steps per (Delta, description) request of the chosen candidate, and of all 16 ranked candidates, pooled per shot index
semantics.sharing: pre-declared: one live execution per distinct level x candidate chosen by any arm, seed or shot; every episode choosing it reads the same live verdict (execution is deterministic: #104 replay 160/160)
semantics.stop: first pass, or the shot budget 3 spent, or a typed engine failure
semantics.typed_failure: a typed engine failure of a chosen launch is recorded, never retried; the episode ends as typed_failure and counts as not passed

statistics.bootstrap: level-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, PCG64 7201 (p94.bootstrap), DESCRIPTIVE
statistics.cells: (level, seed); seed-free arms repeat per seed; random seed s pairs with model seed s

sets.N1-mixed: the N1 levels with at least one recorded passing grid candidate (declared subset)
sets.N2-appearance: 40 #110 evaluation appearance levels (novelty level 1, novel side), reported separately

statistics.token_rule: delta = 0.02 on the pass@3 difference: supported iff mean >= delta and lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper bound < delta; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient (c2.token)
